verifiedParcelResponse.pagination: Static 22,117,499-byte JS GeoJSON bundle. Only 16,384-byte prefix requested, three complete sanitized features retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: L&DO-managed Delhi properties only, not the full Delhi cadastre. The fresh sample is in Malviya Nagar, about 10 km south of the saved WUP centre.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three property polygons in the named static bundle.

viewerInspection: Current public viewer still loads Property_25999.js and other static layers. Inspected its 116,101-byte mains.js; no geometry bbox query or server-side exact-ID feature API found. Its property search operates on loaded layer properties.
technicalBlocker: The earlier full-snapshot audit found repeated propertyid, unique_propert_id and paired identifiers with conflicting geometry. The fresh three-feature prefix confirms availability but does not resolve that native-identity failure.
nextStep: Establish a publisher-supported durable property identity or a separately identified subset before designing complete snapshot, viewport and exact-ID retrieval.
